text:
dario: Quick question — for the embeddings endpoint semantics, are we keeping quota charged on the preflight estimate or the post-split actual units? :thinking:
emily: Right now billing is conservative: we charge the preflight estimate header. That's the current contract for hosted customers.
sasha: That causes weirdness when clients under-estimate dims (sparse vectors) and we later split into 4 shards. Users get billed more than they expected.
marcus: We discussed switching to post-process billing but worried about gamability and added complexity for Dedicated tenants.
dario: The new ask from support is: surface an "estimated_units" in console and in the API response so customers understand cost before the split. Also add a mismatch telemetry metric.
emily: Agree on UX. Proposal: API returns header `X-Embed-Estimate` with our conservative unit estimate and `X-Embed-Actual-Units` in the final response when splitting occurs.
marcus: Implementation challenge: streaming responses — we can't compute actual units until split decisions finish. For streaming fastpath we already skip some accounting.
console-team: Can dashboard show both: estimated vs observed aggregated by route/model? We can add a heatmap for estimate_mismatch_ratio.
sasha: Telemetry names: `embed.estimate_units`, `embed.actual_units`, `embed.estimate_mismatch_count` and `embed.split_count`. Also tag with `dim_sparsity_bucket`.
dario: Suggested routing policy tweak: if `dim_sparsity_bucket == sparse` route to dedicated small-dim pool that avoids splitting even if payload larger; reduces mismatch and latency. Thoughts?
emily: That helps latency but increases unit-cost for dense clients if routed incorrectly. Need fair routing rules. Maybe add a confidence score in preflight.
marcus: Operationally, we can canary the routing change behind `embed_preflight_v2` flag at 10% of traffic for high-usage tenants. monitor `embed.estimate_mismatch_count` and p95 latency.
console-team: For rollout UX — show canary toggle, % traffic, and live metric sparkline. Add an alert when mismatch_ratio > 15% or p95 increases > 20%.
sasha: Edge case: client libraries that manually chunk requests will result in double-counting if we switch to post-process billing. Need clear migration docs.
dario: Action items: 1) eng-platform implement `X-Embed-Estimate` + final `X-Embed-Actual-Units`. 2) runtime team add `dim_sparsity_bucket` tag and `split_count` metric. 3) console add dashboard panels + canary toggle. 4) billing decide lease/retro billing policy for Dedicated.
emily: I'll file infra tickets and draft API change note. Also add a short migration guide for SDKs.
marcus: I'll own the canary plan and alert thresholds. Ops-bot: deploy windows?
ops-bot: Deploy window requested: 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC (LOW RISK).
console-team: Added dashboard mockups to the docs page: https://go.redwood/embed-estimates (WIP).
dario: Thanks all — if no objections I'll start the RFC today and tag Billing + Legal for the Dedicated billing semantics. :rocket:
